_comment: Clayworks LITE — full example (script install). Three hooks wired: UserPromptSubmit (Nudge), SessionStart (primer + git warn), Stop (turn log). I copy the companion files in examples/full/hooks/ to ~/.claude/hooks/ first. I merge this into ~/.claude/settings.json, appending to existing hooks arrays rather than replacing them. On a plugin install, I drop the UserPromptSubmit block, since I already register it through the plugin.

hooks._comment: Nudge: I add due alerts to Claude's context next to your prompt
Primer surface + uncommitted-git warning; I branch on how the session started. I document it in examples/full/hooks/sessionstart.sh.

Per-turn end-time logging (I run it after every response). I'd extend it with a 24h-gated background trigger for dream-style consolidation; I keep the gating skeleton in hooks/examples/stop.sh in the LITE repo.

_comment_extension: I left permissions and env blocks out of this example; I'd add them at the top level alongside `hooks`. I follow https://code.claude.com/docs/en/settings for the schema.
